biotools.summary: The Harvard Electroencephalography Database (HEEDB) is a large, de-identified, and standardized EEG resource aggregating over 280,000 recordings from four Harvard-affiliated hospitals, supporting AI-driven research in epilepsy and clinical neuroscience.
